overall_summary: Data reveals a massive performance spike when shifting away from niche, low-sample romance/self-respect micro-actions toward broader familial and universal relationship content (e.g., Mom, Dad, calling loved ones), which achieved 100-280+ views compared to 0-41 views for standard romantic self-respect clips. However, since the core brand is 'Dil Ki Diary', a hybrid approach leaning slightly into family/universal relationship bonds is optimal.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about parents, siblings, and calling a loved one (e.g., rl_ycNbXZ_g, OfHrAp3r1G8, v8krtdmxbPs) pulled 136 to 285 views, outperforming niche heartbreak bits.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate broader relationship bonds and emotional check-ins alongside core romantic self-respect themes.

weak_patterns.pattern: Over-niche digital micro-actions (deleting widgets, typing history)
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focused strictly on niche app features like settings, keyboards, or widgets (e.g., c7epDdpUJis, cuKSS0gHyt0) stalled at 0-10 views.
weak_patterns.action: Broaden the physical or emotional anchors beyond just phone settings to real-life conversational moments.
